indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: B4.1.3.1 Develop an understanding of equivalent and improper fractions 12 × 12
indicator.objective: Recognise fractions that are greater than one (i.e. improper fractions), draw and label such fractions with their symbols

skills.description: Convert improper fractions to mixed fractions.
Convert mixed fractions to improper fractions.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.
misconceptions: Multiplying the wrong numbers during conversion (e.g., multiplying denominator by numerator instead of whole number).

questions.stem: Which of these is an improper fraction?
hints: Look at the numerator and denominator.
An improper fraction has a numerator larger than or equal to the denominator.
questions.explanation: 5/4 is improper because the numerator (5) is larger than the denominator (4).
questions.misconception: Choosing 3/4 because the numbers are larger.

questions.stem: Convert 3/2 to a mixed fraction.
questions.explanation: 3/2 means 3 divided by 2. 2 goes into 3 once, with a remainder of 1. So it is 1 1/2.

questions.stem: How many wholes are in the improper fraction 7/3?
hints: How many times does 3 go into 7?
questions.explanation: 7 divided by 3 is 2 remainder 1. There are 2 wholes.

questions.stem: Convert 1 1/4 to an improper fraction.
How many whole circles would you shade to show 5/4?
hints: It is 1 whole and 1/4, so you need parts of a second circle.
questions.explanation: 5/4 is greater than 1, so you need 1 full circle and a part of a second circle.

questions.stem: Convert 9/4 to a mixed fraction. What is the whole number part?
questions.explanation: 9 divided by 4 is 2 remainder 1. The whole number is 2.

questions.stem: Convert 2 1/3 to an improper fraction.
hints: Multiply the whole number by the denominator (2 x 3 = 6).

questions.stem: Which mixed fraction is equal to 11/5?
In the mixed fraction 4 2/5, what is the numerator when converted to an improper fraction?
Convert 7/2 to a mixed fraction.
If you draw 2 whole rectangles and shade 3/4 of another, what improper fraction does this represent?
Which of these is equal to 3 1/2?
Convert 17/4 to a mixed fraction. What is the whole number?
Convert 9/8 to a mixed fraction.
Convert 5 2/3 to an improper fraction. What is the numerator?
Explain how to draw a diagram to represent the improper fraction 7/3.
hints: How many thirds are left over?
questions.explanation: 7/3 is 2 wholes and 1/3. You would draw 2 fully shaded circles (or shapes) and a third circle with only 1 part shaded out of 3.

criteria.description: Identifies 1/3 shaded in the third shape.

questions.stem: A pupil converts 2 4/5 to an improper fraction and gets 14/5. Are they correct?
hints: Multiply the whole number by the denominator.
questions.misconception: Adding all numbers instead of multiplying.

questions.stem: Explain the steps to convert 15/4 into a mixed fraction.
hints: Divide the numerator by the denominator.
The quotient is the whole number, the remainder is the new numerator.
questions.explanation: Divide 15 by 4. 4 goes into 15 three times (12), with a remainder of 3. The mixed fraction is 3 3/4.

criteria.description: Identifies 3 as the whole number and 3 as the numerator.

questions.stem: Which is greater: 11/4 or 2 1/2?
A recipe calls for 5/2 cups of flour. Draw a representation of this amount using measuring cups. Explain your drawing.
hints: How much of the next cup?
questions.explanation: 5/2 = 2 1/2. You would draw 2 full cups and a third cup that is half full (1/2).

criteria.description: Draws a third cup that is 1/2 full.
